runtime.unifiedRulePlan: ability page route rule plan exposes static_rule.pathPattern beside slug and redirect dynamic rules without adding request hot-path checks
runtime.routeRulePlanApi: admin route-rule.plan returns enabled slug/redirect prefixes and persisted static_rule rows with submit-time warnings
runtime.routeRuleValidateApi: admin route-rule.validate scans static_rule.pathPattern with bounded limit and reports warnings without request hot-path checks
runtime.routeRuleListApi: admin route-rule.list exposes static route snapshots beside slug and redirect rules
runtime.routeRuleSaveApi: admin route-rule.save validates and stores editable URL rules with regex compile status and submit-time warnings
runtime.routeRuleStatusApi: admin route-rule.status enables or disables an editable URL rule and returns table rows
runtime.routeRuleSortApi: admin route-rule.sort updates editable URL rule priority in a bounded batch and returns table rows
runtime.routeRuleStatsApi: admin route-rule.stats returns read-only aggregate counts from the unified URL rule snapshot table
runtime.routeRuleRefreshApi: admin route-rule.refresh rewrites the unified URL rule snapshot table on demand and returns bounded sync counts
runtime.routeRulePlanUi: ability page renders the unified URL rule plan as route source and static rule tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.routeRuleValidateUi: ability page renders bounded URL rule validation warnings as a table without request hot-path checks
runtime.routeRuleStatsUi: ability page renders unified URL rule snapshot stats by pack and rule type
runtime.routeRuleRefreshUi: ability page renders route-rule.refresh as before/synced/after counts while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.routeRuleEditDialogUi: ability page opens a table-row add/edit dialog for URL rules with rule type, source pack, pattern, target path, priority, status and submit-time warning preview
runtime.routeRuleRuntimeRefresh: route-rule.save/status/sort refresh editable dynamic URL rules during admin-time and return runtimeRefreshed, runtimeRouteCount and routeRefreshError
runtime.backgroundTaskSchema: content_background_task is created only when static, sitemap or import-export task-capable packs are enabled and contains task_type, target_type, target_id, status, progress, payload, result, error, retry and timestamps
runtime.backgroundTaskStaticGenerate: static.generate keeps the small synchronous path and records a completed content.static.generate row in content_background_task with backgroundTaskId in the response
runtime.backgroundTaskStaticRetryFailed: static.task.retry-failed keeps the bounded synchronous retry path and records a content.static.retryFailed row in content_background_task with backgroundTaskId in the response
runtime.independentRouteRuleStore: content_route_rule snapshot is created only when slug, redirect or static packs are enabled and is refreshed by admin plan/validate calls
runtime.routeRuleEditableContract: content_route_rule exposes sourcePack, matchPattern, targetPath, priority, compileStatus, compileMessage and managedFlag for the unified editable URL rule model
runtime.rulePreview: admin static.rule.preview expands pathPattern with a bounded content sample and returns warning, relativePath and artifactUrl without changing request routing
runtime.rulePreviewUi: ability page renders static.rule.preview as path/template/target/output/warning table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.taskPersistenceStatus: static task status is corrected to failed when artifact persistence fails after render
runtime.ruleStatusValidation: static.rule.save normalizes status to enabled(1) or disabled(0)
runtime.taskRetry: admin can retry an existing static task by reusing its rule and target with bounded request size
runtime.taskRetryFailed: admin can retry failed static tasks in a bounded batch controlled by maxTaskRetryRows
runtime.taskRetryFailedUi: ability page renders static.task.retry-failed as bounded summary and per-task result tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.adminStats: static.stats returns rule/task/artifact totals and status aggregates for admin diagnostics
runtime.adminStatsUi: ability page renders static.stats as rule, task, artifact and status aggregate tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.generateResultUi: ability page renders static.generate as task id, artifact path, result and message table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.cleanResultUi: ability page renders static.clean as a bounded cleanup result table while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.taskStatusFilter: static.task.list accepts optional status filter -1/0/1 with bounded limit for admin diagnostics
runtime.taskRuleTargetFilter: static.task.list accepts optional ruleId and targetId filters with bounded limit for admin diagnostics
runtime.artifactTargetFilter: static.artifact.list accepts optional targetId filter for content artifact diagnostics
runtime.artifactPathFilter: static.artifact.list accepts optional path substring filter for admin artifact diagnostics without changing static serving
